name: Paraform
tagline: Agentic hiring marketplace pairing AI sourcing with expert recruiters.
description: Paraform is an agentic hiring marketplace that connects companies with thousands of specialized recruiters, augmented by AI agents that learn each search, surface candidates, schedule interviews, and handle follow-ups. Companies pay on successful hires rather than for software seats. Used by 1,000+ companies, often for high-compensation technical roles.
insight: Raised a $40M Series B (Scale Venture Partners) in 2026 for $65M total; backers include execs from Palantir, Stripe, and Canva.
edge: Pairs AI sourcing agents with a 10,000+ vetted recruiter marketplace, betting on humans-in-the-loop over fully automated candidate sourcing.

references.title: Paraform: $65M Raised for Agentic Hiring Platform
